lists.title: Mexico City: Day of the Dead weekend

places.name: Paseo de la Reforma

lists.title: Sydney: jacaranda season

places.name: bills Surry Hills

places.name: Grafton Jacaranda Festival
places.why: Road trip north: Oct 30–Nov 8, 2026.

lists.title: Sedona: a two-day 40th
lists.hook: A Sedona 40th while the leaves turn gold

places.name: Cathedral Rock
places.why: Day 1, early: the free Sedona Shuttle runs Thursday–Sunday, about 7am–5:30pm, to the trailhead.

places.name: Pink Adventure Tours
places.why: The Broken Arrow off-road ride, about 2 hours, with a walking stop at Submarine Rock or Chicken Point.

places.name: Crescent Moon Picnic Site
places.why: Golden hour at Red Rock Crossing: open 8am–6pm through Nov 30, day-use fee at the gate.

places.name: Elote Cafe
places.why: Birthday dinner, Tuesday–Saturday from 5pm. Reserve ahead.

places.name: L'Auberge de Sedona

places.name: Soldier Pass Trail

lists.title: Kyoto: fall color, late Nov to early Dec 2026
lists.hook: Kyoto's 2026 fall color forecast is out

places.name: Arashiyama
places.why: Maples on the hills above Togetsukyō Bridge; forecast best from about Nov 24.

places.name: Kiyomizu-dera
places.why: Evening Special Visit Nov 21–30, 5:30–9:30pm (last entry 9pm); no reservation needed.

places.name: Tōfuku-ji

places.name: Okutan Nanzenji
places.why: Yudofu (silky simmered tofu) near Nanzen-ji temple. Closed Thursdays.

places.name: Omen Ginkakuji

places.name: HOSHINOYA Kyoto
places.why: Where we'd stay (our pick): a riverside retreat in Arashiyama; guests arrive by private boat.

lists.title: Zion with a stroller: one fall day
lists.hook: Zion turns gold now. Bring the stroller.

places.name: Pa'rus Trail
places.why: Paved and gentle along the river from the visitor center; NPS rates it wheelchair accessible with assistance.

places.name: Zion Canyon Shuttle
places.why: Free, no ticket: first bus 7am, last up-canyon 5pm, through Nov 28. Strollers ride the front rack; you load them.

places.name: Riverside Walk
places.why: For older kids and teens: about 2 miles round trip from the Temple of Sinawava stop.

places.name: Zion Canyon Visitor Center
places.why: Free Junior Ranger booklets for ages 4 and up.

places.name: Oscar's Cafe
places.why: Big breakfast burritos in town before the first bus.

places.name: Red Rock Grill
places.why: Sit-down lunch at Zion Lodge, right on the shuttle line.

lists.title: Tromsø in November: orcas and northern lights
lists.hook: Orcas and northern lights, one Tromsø week

places.name: Skjervøy
places.why: Orcas and humpbacks usually follow the herring into these fjords from early November to the end of January; whale trips from Tromsø run about 7–8 hours.

places.name: Fjellheisen
places.why: Cable car to 421 m, open 9am to midnight. During construction, use the free temporary lot at Solstrandvegen 30.

places.name: Fiskekompaniet
places.why: Seafood in the city centre: oysters, roe, seasonal shellfish. Lunch and dinner Monday–Saturday.

lists.title: Kyoto: the list Pip saved for us

places.name: Kiyomizu-dera
places.why: Our must-do: the Evening Special Visit, Nov 21–30.

places.name: Tōfuku-ji
places.why: Maples under the Tsūten-kyō bridge; book the dawn viewing ahead.

places.name: Arashiyama

places.name: Okutan Nanzenji
places.why: Yudofu lunch near Nanzen-ji (closed Thursdays).

places.name: Omen Ginkakuji
places.why: Thick udon below the Silver Pavilion.

places.name: HOSHINOYA Kyoto
places.why: Our pick for a stay, reached by private boat.

lists.title: Puerto Rico: the glowing-bay week
lists.hook: Puerto Rico's glowing bay: darkest nights are now

places.name: Laguna Grande
places.why: Night kayak through a red mangrove channel, about 2 hours, no swimming. With Kayaking Puerto Rico, kids from 6 can go (ages 6–13 share a kayak with an adult).

places.name: Castillo San Felipe del Morro
places.why: Fly a kite on the fort's breezy green lawn.

places.name: Café Manolín
places.why: Mofongo with your pick of meat or shrimp in Old San Juan; open daily for breakfast and lunch.

lists.title: Nashville: a two-day crew weekend
lists.hook: The Nashville weekend your group chat actually wants

places.name: Arnold's Country Kitchen
places.why: Friday lunch: meat-and-three. Weekdays 10:30am–2:45pm, Saturday brunch 11am–3pm.

places.name: Prince's Hot Chicken
places.why: At Assembly Food Hall on Broadway, or the original on Nolensville Pike. Pick one heat level milder than planned.

places.name: Robert's Western World
places.why: Classic country, live seven days a week. Lower Broadway honky-tonks charge no cover; most go 21+ after 8pm.

places.name: Grand Ole Opry House
places.why: Opry night: November shows start at 7pm. Book on opry.com.

places.name: Gaylord Opryland Resort
places.why: A Country Christmas, Nov 6–Jan 2: millions of lights in the same complex as the Opry House.

lists.title: Lake Tekapo: lupins and dark skies
lists.hook: Purple lupins by day, Milky Way by night

places.name: Lake Tekapo
places.why: Lupins usually peak late November to mid-December. Walk west along the beach from the church; look, don't pick, stay on paths.

places.name: Church of the Good Shepherd
places.why: Grounds open 9am–8pm in summer; no night access inside the fence and no photos inside the church.

places.name: Dark Sky Project
places.why: The Summit Experience up Mt John: about 1h45, ages 10 and up; what you see depends on weather and moon.

places.name: Kohan
places.why: Sushi and salmon sashimi, with salmon farms right on the doorstep.

lists.title: Vienna: first bites and Christmas markets
lists.hook: Landed in Vienna? Eat these two first.

places.name: Figlmüller
places.why: On Wollzeile since 1905: pork schnitzel pounded to about a foot across, with lemon and potato salad.

places.name: Café Sacher Wien
places.why: The Original Sacher-Torte, first made in 1832; have it with unsweetened whipped cream.

places.name: Wiener Christkindlmarkt, Rathausplatz
places.why: Opens Fri, Nov 13: daily 10am–10pm through Dec 26, ice rink through Jan 6.

places.name: Schönbrunn Palace Christmas Market
places.why: Open since Nov 6: daily 10am–9pm through Dec 23, shorter hours until Jan 6.

lists.title: Plymouth, Massachusetts: Thanksgiving week with kids
lists.hook: Thanksgiving in Plymouth, Massachusetts: book dinner now

places.why: Two ticketed Thanksgiving Day meals (Thu, Nov 26); last year's sittings sold out. Harvest Feast fallback on Nov 21 and 27.

places.name: Historic Patuxet Homesite
places.why: For older kids: the Native peoples who have lived here for over 12,000 years. Open daily 9am–5pm through Nov 29.

places.name: Mayflower II
places.why: The full-scale reproduction of the 1620 ship, back at her State Pier berth since July.

places.name: Plymouth Waterfront
places.why: Sat, Nov 21: America's Hometown Thanksgiving Parade, with a Children's Pavilion for little ones.

places.name: Wood's Seafood
places.why: Fried clams and fish & chips on Town Wharf; open daily year-round.

lists.title: Chiang Mai: lantern night, Tue Nov 24

places.name: Wat Phan Tao
places.why: A teak hall in the Old City hung with paper lanterns for Yi Peng; quieter in the early evening.

places.name: Tha Phae Gate
places.why: The festival's main stage and Lanna lantern contest; the krathong parade runs from Tha Phae Road to the river.

places.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep

lists.title: Marrakech: our crew's four picks

places.why: A cobalt-blue garden, open daily 8am–5:30pm; tickets sold only online, on its official site.

places.name: Nomad
places.why: Modern Moroccan on two rooftop terraces over the Rahba Kedima spice square; book and ask for the top terrace.

places.name: Al Fassia

places.name: Agafay Desert
places.why: The desert just outside the city, for a sunset camel ride and dinner.

lists.title: Palm Springs + Joshua Tree: a desert bachelorette
lists.hook: Bachelorette in the desert: pools, tram, Joshua trees

places.name: Parker Palm Springs
places.why: Where we'd stay (our pick): three pools and a pétanque court by the lemonade stand.

places.name: VillageFest
places.why: Every Thursday, 6–10pm, October to May: nearly 200 vendors along Palm Canyon Drive.

places.name: Sherman's Deli & Bakery
places.why: A deli since 1963: pastrami for brunch, then a slab of cake.

places.name: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway
places.why: The world's largest rotating tram cars climb to 8,516 feet; open again since Oct 5.

places.name: Hidden Valley Nature Trail

places.why: An easy 1-mile loop through boulders; park by 9am on busy weekends, and come back after dark to stargaze.

places.name: Keys View
places.location: Joshua Tree National Park, California, USA
places.why: A paved viewpoint over the Coachella Valley; on clear days, Signal Mountain in Mexico, 90 miles south.

places.name: Pappy & Harriet's
places.why: Barbecue and live music in a 1946 movie-set town; no reservations for 8 or fewer (bigger groups email ahead); show tickets separate.

lists.title: San Diego: Thanksgiving week, toddler to teen
lists.hook: Thanksgiving week in San Diego, toddler to teen

places.name: Hotel del Coronado
places.why: Skating by the Sea opens Fri, Nov 20 (through Jan 3): double-runner skates for toddlers; under-12s skate with an adult.

places.name: La Jolla Cove
places.why: Watch the sea lions from the walkway; next-door Point La Jolla is closed to people to protect them.

places.name: Old Town Mexican Café
places.why: Tortillas made by hand; opens 7am on weekends, 8am on weekdays.

places.name: Hodad's
places.why: Ocean Beach burgers under walls of license plates; expect a line.

lists.title: Torres del Paine: a dome and the big days
lists.hook: Where we'd stay in Patagonia: a dome

places.why: Our editorial pick: geodesic domes in the heart of the park; Suite domes have wood stoves, Suite Lofts sleep up to four.

places.name: Mirador Base Las Torres
places.why: About 20 km round trip, roughly 8 hours; trail entry until 9:30am; rangers may require microspikes and poles.

places.name: Grey Glacier
places.why: The Grey III sails from Hotel Lago Grey to the ice face, weather permitting.

places.name: El Asador Patagónico
places.why: Cordero al palo: Patagonian lamb roasted on a spit by the fire; book ahead.

lists.title: NYC: the 100th Macy's Parade with kids
lists.hook: The 100th Macy's Parade, done right with kids

places.name: American Museum of Natural History

places.name: Levain Bakery

places.name: Contramar

places.name: Panadería Rosetta

places.why: Saturday's low tide dips to about 0.2 ft around 1pm; tide pools close at 4:30, and there's no cell signal down there.

places.name: Old Town Mexican Café

places.name: Hodad's

lists.title: New Orleans: Thanksgiving weekend with your crew
lists.hook: Thanksgiving weekend in New Orleans with your crew

places.name: Caesars Superdome
places.why: Fri, Nov 27: Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands and Greek Show. Sat, Nov 28: Southern vs. Grambling, kickoff 1pm.

places.name: New Orleans City Park
places.why: Celebration in the Oaks: holiday lights through the live oaks, Nov 27 to Jan 1.

places.name: Café Du Monde

places.why: The rooftop above the Rahba Kedima spice square: calamari with chermoula, slow lamb shoulder. Sunset is around 5:30pm now; book ahead.

places.name: Al Fassia
places.why: On Boulevard Mohammed Zerktouni in Gueliz, run by women since 1987: little salads, pastilla, then a tagine.

places.name: Agafay Desert
places.why: Rocky hills, a sunset camel ride, then dinner by the fire; nights get cool, so bring a layer.

lists.title: Rovaniemi with kids in December
lists.hook: Lapland with kids in December: where we'd stay

places.name: Arctic TreeHouse Hotel
places.why: Our pick, on the Arctic Circle: a family of four fits the two-bedroom Arctic GlassHouse, with its own sauna. Best with school-age kids.

places.name: Santa Claus Village
places.why: Walkable from the hotel. Free entry; Santa's office open daily 8am–8pm from Nov 30.

places.name: SantaPark
places.why: Right next door: an underground Christmas park with Elf School and Mrs. Gingerbread's Bakery, open all December.

places.name: Ranua Wildlife Park
places.location: Ranua, Finland (about an hour's drive south of Rovaniemi)
places.why: Finland's only polar bears; open every day from 10am.

places.name: Arktikum
places.why: Science centre and museum for a warm afternoon: daily 10–6 in December, closed Dec 24.

places.name: Restaurant Nili
places.why: Family-owned Lappish kitchen downtown: sautéed reindeer with mash and lingonberries. Book ahead.

places.name: Huskypoint
places.why: Sled-dog rides from early December, snow permitting: the teen pick.

lists.title: Cape Town with kids: penguins, cable car, chips
lists.hook: Cape Town with kids: penguins, cable car, chips

places.why: Wheelchair-friendly boardwalks to Foxy Beach, where African penguins nest a few meters away. Look, don't touch: critically endangered.

places.name: Table Mountain Aerial Cableway
places.why: The round cars' floors turn 360° on the 4–5 minute ride. Buy online and check the status that morning: wind closes it often.

places.name: Kalky's
places.why: Battered or grilled hake and chips at picnic tables on a working harbour. Go early on weekends.

places.name: Franschhoek Wine Tram
places.why: The parents' day: hop on and off between wine estates by tram and tram-bus; tastings cost extra.

lists.title: Chiang Mai: eat first, float later

places.why: Chicken khao soi by the old city's North Gate (Sri Poom 8 Alley). Lunch only, closed Sundays: get there by 10:30.

places.name: Huen Phen
places.why: Northern Thai on Ratchamanka Road: the khan toke set with nam prik ong, nam prik noom, sai ua and sticky rice.

places.name: Chang Phueak Gate

places.name: Nawarat Bridge

places.name: Eichardt's Private Hotel

lists.title: Lapland: the family vote
lists.hook: Plan next year's family trip at the table

places.name: Santa Claus Village
places.why: Santa's office on the Arctic Circle is open every day: the little cousins' first vote.

places.name: Ranua Wildlife Park
places.location: Ranua, Finland (about an hour's drive south of Rovaniemi)
places.why: Finland's only polar bears.

places.name: Arktikum
places.why: Science centre and museum, open daily in December (closed Dec 24).

places.name: Huskypoint
places.why: Sled-dog rides from early December, snow permitting: the teens' vote.

places.name: Restaurant Nili
places.why: Sautéed reindeer with mash and lingonberries for the whole table.

lists.title: Tromsø: polar night

places.name: Tromsø
places.why: Nov 27 brings the last sunrise until about Jan 15; midday still glows pink, purple and deep blue.

places.name: Fjellheisen
places.why: Cable car to Storsteinen every half hour, 9am to midnight: blue hour, the lit city, aurora on clear nights.

places.name: Skjervøy

places.name: Malangen Resort

places.why: Where we'd sleep: fjord-view cabins and rooms, with transfers from town several times a day.

lists.title: Plymouth, Massachusetts: last weekend of the season
lists.hook: Plimoth Patuxet's last weekend of the season

places.name: Historic Patuxet Homesite

places.name: Plymouth Rock
